activePromotions.title: Tikra Rida
activePromotions.officialDescription: Flip used cars in Vilnius. Read the ads, meet the seller, haggle — but the ad might be lying. Buy the history report, or trust your gut. Wash it, fix it, photograph it, and sell it for more than you paid. Full Lithuanian and English.

activePromotions.title: IVAN (Iter Vehemens ad Necem)
activePromotions.officialDescription: A roguelike classic. Gain items of great magic, attain powerful equipment made of mysterious materials, bathe in the blessings of mighty gods and recruit loyal allies of various shapes and sizes.

activePromotions.title: Forbidden House
activePromotions.officialDescription: Forbidden House is a first-person puzzle adventure with over 40 puzzles to solve.

activePromotions.title: Mystic Fog Maze
activePromotions.officialDescription: 謎めいた霧に包まれた終わりのない迷路を、プレイヤーが進んでいくカジュアルなパズルゲーム。

activePromotions.title: 萌爪造万物
activePromotions.officialDescription: Run a workshop that keeps moving while you plan: gather and process resources, discover cauldron recipes, forge randomized gear, build a party from four classes, and connect combat, orders, and a player market into one persistent economy. Internet connection and account login required.

activePromotions.title: Age of Wonders 4
activePromotions.officialDescription: 自分でデザインしたファンタジーの世界を統治しよう！ 4Xストラテジーと戦略的なターン制バトルが特異な融合を果たした「Age of Wonders」で、新たな魔法の世界を探検しよう。ターンごとに発展していく帝国とともに成長・変化する派閥を支配しよう！
tags: ターン制ストラテジー
キャラクターカスタマイズ

activePromotions.title: PAYDAY 3
activePromotions.officialDescription: 『PAYDAY 3』は1〜4人協力プレイのFPSであり、世界一象徴的な街を舞台にした究極のヒーストファンタジーだ。痕跡を残さず消え去るか、銃弾の雨をくぐり抜けるか。どちらにせよ、獲物を手に脱出しろ。
tags: オンライン協力プレイ
